name: Spinnaker
description: Spinnaker is a continuous delivery and infrastructure management platform for hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud, and Kubernetes. Leverage Spinnaker to deploy with more consistency, automation, and safety, increasing your pace of software innovation by orders of magnitude.

children.name: Spinnaker - Overview
children.description: An overview dashboard that provides at a quick glance the health and usage of your Spinnaker instance - from applications deployed, clusters targeted, pipelines run and users in spinnaker.

panels.name: Active Apps
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker application
| json field=_raw "content.uri"  as content_uri
| where content_uri contains "/applications/"
| parse regex field=content_uri "\/applications\/(?<application>.+?)/.+"
| count_distinct(application)

panels.name: Active Clusters
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker deploy account name 
| parse regex "deploy.account.name\"\:\"(?<cluster>.+?)\".+"
| count_distinct(%cluster) as clusters

panels.name: Active Pipelines
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker 
| json field=_raw "content.execution.name" as pipeline
| count_distinct(pipeline) as pipelines

panels.name: Active Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker content user 
| json field=_raw "content.user" as user
| count_distinct(user) as Users

panels.name: Active Apps
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker application
| json "content.uri" as content_uri
| where content_uri contains "/applications/"
| parse regex field=content_uri "\/applications\/(?<application>.+?)/.+"
| timeslice 1d
| count_distinct(application) as applications by _timeslice

panels.name: Activity by App
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker application
| json field=_raw "details.type" as type
| json field=_raw "content.uri"  as content_uri
| where content_uri contains "/applications/"
| parse regex field=content_uri "\/applications\/(?<application>.+?)/.+"
| timeslice 1d
| count _timeslice, application
| transpose row _timeslice column application

panels.name: Active Clusters
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker 
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop
| parse regex "deploy.account.name\"\:\"(?<cluster>.+?)\".+"
| timeslice 1d 
| count_distinct(%cluster) as clusters by _timeslice

panels.name: API Calls by Cluster
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker) orca task 
| json field=_raw  "content.execution.name", "details.type"as pipeline, logtype nodrop 
| json field=_raw "$['content']['context']['deploy.account.name']" as cluster
| where logType contains "orca:task"
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice, cluster
| transpose row _timeslice column cluster

panels.name: Active Pipelines
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker content execution name
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop
| where pipeline!=""
| timeslice 1d
| count_distinct(pipeline) as pipelines by _timeslice

panels.name: API Calls by Pipeline
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker pipeline content execution type 
| json field=_raw "content.execution.type" as type | where type="PIPELINE"
| json field=_raw "content.execution.name" as Pipeline
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice, %pipeline
| transpose row _timeslice column %pipeline

panels.name: Active Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker content user 
| json field=_raw "content.user" as user
| timeslice 1d
| count_distinct(user) as users by _timeslice

panels.name: API Calls by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker authentication user 
| json field=_raw "content.execution.authentication.user" as User | if (isNull(%User), "spinnaker",user) as user
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice, user
| transpose row _timeslice column user

children.name: Spinnaker - Pipelines
children.description: A dashboard that contains pipeline execution history and metrics including most common errors.

panels.name: Pipeline Execution History Comparison
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker orca pipeline
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop
| where logType contains "orca:pipeline"
| count by status 
| compare with timeshift 14d
| _count as  %"Last 14 Days" | _count_14d as %"Previous 14 Days" | fields -_count,_count_14d

panels.name: Pipeline Execution History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker orca pipeline
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop | where status != "RUNNING" and logType contains "orca:pipeline"
| timeslice by 1d
| count by Status, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column Status

panels.name: Stage History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker orca stage details type
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop 
| where logType contains "orca:stage" 
| timeslice by 1d 
| count by _timeslice, logType
| transpose row _timeslice column logType

panels.name: Pipelines Executed by Name
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker  orca pipeline starting
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name","content.execution.trigger.type","content.execution.authentication.user" as status,application,logType,pipeline, triggerType, user nodrop 
| where logType = "orca:pipeline:starting"
| timeslice by 1d
| count by _timeslice, pipeline
| transpose row _timeslice column pipeline

panels.name: Failed Tasks
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker orca task failed content context exception operation
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name","content.context.exception.operation" as status,application,logType,pipeline, task nodrop 
| where logType contains "orca:task:failed" and task!=""
| count by task | order by _count desc

panels.name: Pipelines Failed (not Cancelled)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker  orca pipeline failed 
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name"as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop 
| where logType contains "orca:pipeline:failed" and status != "CANCELED"
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice, application
| transpose row _timeslice column application

panels.name: Errors
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker content  context exception details errors
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop 
| json field=_raw "content.context.exception.details.errors" as error | where error != "[]"
| count by error | order by _count desc

panels.name: Pipelines Complete
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker orca pipeline complete
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name"as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop 
| where logType contains "orca:pipeline:complete"
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice, application
| transpose row _timeslice column application

children.name: Spinnaker - User Activity
children.description: A dashboard that contains user activity, manual judgments, rollbacks, canary, and trigger metrics.

panels.name: Manual Judgments
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker "manualJudgment" details type
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop
| where logType="orca:stage:complete"
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice

panels.name: RollBacks
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker and "undoRolloutManifest"
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop
| where logType contains "orca:stage:complete" 
| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice

panels.name: Canaries
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker  type runCanary
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name" as status,application,logType,pipeline nodrop
| where logType="orca:pipeline:complete"

| timeslice 1d
| count by _timeslice

panels.name: User Activity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker content user
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name","content.user" as status,application,logType,pipeline,user nodrop
| where user != "anonymous" and !isNull(user)
| timeslice by 1d
| count_distinct(_timeslice) as days by user
| order by days desc

panels.name: Distinct User by Day
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name","content.user" as status,application,logType,pipeline,user nodrop
| where user != "anonymous" and !isNull(user)
| timeslice by 1d 
| count_distinct(user) as user group by _timeslice

panels.name: Pipeline Runs by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker orca pipeline complete
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name","content.execution.authentication.user" as status,application,logType,pipeline,user2 nodrop
| where logType = "orca:pipeline:complete"
| if (ISNULL(user2), "anonymous", user2) as user
| count by user | order by _count desc

panels.name: Pipelines Trigger Type
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/armory/spinnaker and "jenkins" orca pipeline starting
| json field=_raw "content.execution.status","content.execution.application","details.type","content.execution.name","content.execution.authentication.user","content.execution.trigger.type" as status,application,logType,pipeline,user,triggerType nodrop
| where logType = "orca:pipeline:starting"
| timeslice by 1d
| count by _timeslice, triggerType
| transpose row _timeslice column triggerType
